environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB target group routes to multiple container instances (desired_count=3). No authentication middleware is configured on the ALB or at the application layer. The service is exposed via a public ALB DNS endpoint. Concurrent requests from any client are load-balanced across instances, but within each instance the Spring Boot embedded Tomcat thread pool (max-threads=200) processes requests concurrently, enabling the TOCTOU race condition on the in-memory wallet state.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
